definitions.explanation: The hour four on the clock. Note the irregular reading よ, not し or よん, before the counter {時|じ}.

examples.japanese: {四時|よじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧{四時|よじ}{半|はん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll call at four thirty in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{四時|よじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to get up at four tomorrow morning and take the first train.

notes:
One of the three irregular hour readings that learners must memorize.

IRREGULAR HOUR READINGS:
- {四時|よじ}: four o'clock — ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧, not し or よん
- ⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧: seven o'clock — しち (しちじ is standard; ななじ is heard but non-standard)
- ⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧: nine o'clock — く, not きゅう

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四時|よじ}{半|はん}: half past four
- ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧{四時|よじ}: four a.m.
- {四時|よじ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from four o'clock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {四分|よんぷん}: four minutes — the minute counter takes よん, not ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧
